title: Redfish implementations (all vendors): Redfish replaced IPMI but reintroduced the same class of flaws at the HTTP layer — CVE-2024-54085…
impact: Redfish replaced IPMI but reintroduced the same class of flaws at the HTTP layer — CVE-2024-54085, CVE-2023-34330, CVE-2023-25191/25192, CVE-2018-15774 are all Redfish-surface bugs. The spec mandates no minimum implementation assurance, and every ODM ships its own stack
remediation: Treat Redfish as an untrusted-by-default surface: mTLS or a management-plane proxy in front of every BMC, per-node unique credentials, and no direct operator access. This is architecture work, not patching
